turns.en: My friends, it is now time for us to read.

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Sifunda ngamaqembu. Siyakhumbula ukuthi masifunda ngamaqembu, u-ma'am kuzoba khona iqembu lakhe namhlanje, iqembu lama-kiwi esizoqala ngalo, azohlala nalo phambili, sifunde nalo.
turns.en: We read in groups. We remember that when we read in groups, ma'am will have their group today, the kiwi group which we will start with, they will sit with it in front, we read with it.

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Bese nina abanye nizobe senifunda ngababili, abanye bazofunda ngokuzimela.
turns.en: Then you others will then read in pairs, others will read independently.

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Ukuze silungiselele-ke ukufunda kwethu, asicule-ke iculo lethu lokufunda.
turns.en: In order for us to prepare for our reading, let us sing our reading song.

turns.text: Bantwana bakwethu, asicule ke iculo lethu lokufunda ngamaqembu. Asiqale ke.
turns.en: Children of ours, let us sing our song of reading in groups. Let us start then.
